decisions.reason: As a very recent extension of the firm's core airfield control business in a growing market, it is likely above or close to aspiration and the firm's R&D capacity and organisational slack support keeping it on the market while adoption builds.

This surveillance display also fits the firm's integrated airport-operations trajectory and core capabilities, and with no clear sign of underperformance a boundedly rational management would typically retain it for further learning rather than redeploy resources immediately.
